name: Hide Inactive Clients
description: This utility allows the firm to hide old/inactive clients who have no open matters. Filtered on client opened date since MM/DD/YYYY, and by the Client Originating Timekeeper.

name: Matter Closer
description: Allows the user to close matters based on several criteria or a spreadsheet.

name: Matter Status and Lock Updater
description: The JPS – Matter Status Lock Update Utility allows the firm to update the status (Open, Closed or Final Bill Sent) and the lock setting (allow/disallow time and expenses) for one, multiple or all matters on a single client.

name: Update Bill Copy Settings
description: The JPS Bill Copy Settings Utility allows the user to update each of the bill copy settings (matter address, print, email and export formats) for matters based on client, billing timekeeper or originating timekeeper. The utility also contains a pre-report of client and/or matters to be changed.

name: Bill-Prebill Format Change
description: The JPS - Bill-Prebill Format Change Utility updates the bill and/or prebill formats for clients/matters based on selection criteria.

name: Split Management Utility
description: The JPS Split Management Utility allows the user to remove splits, modify splits, add new splits, or copy splits from a master matter to multiple matters.

name: Split Matter Closer
description: This utility allows the firm to close split matters for specific or all matters for a client, or by Billing Timekeeper or Last Bill date, provided they meet the constraints to close.

name: Hide Inactive Users/Tkprs
description: This utility allows the user to inactivate timekeepers and/or users that have not had any activity since a selected date.

name: Activity Code
description: The JPS Activity Code Reassignment Utility updates the Activity Code references from one Activity Code to a different Activity Code with an option to delete the From Activity Code.

name: Fee Schedule
description: The JPS - Fee Schedule Reassignment 4.0 Utility allows the user to change the Fee Schedule for matters and/or clients in a bulk manner by their respective practice classes, office and/or clients.

name: Fee Schedule Copy
description: The JPS Fee Schedule Copy Utility allows the user to create a new fee schedule based on an existing one. This means the tool creates a new fee schedule and copies the fee schedule information from Timekeepers, Personnel Types, and Task Codes.

name: Practice Class
description: The JPS Practice Class Reassignment Utility allows the user to change the practice class for client and/or matters with option to choose specific billing timekeepers. Includes option to delete the FROM Practice Class code once it has been reassigned. Utility also contains a pre- and post-report of client and/or matters to be changed, with an option to delete the From Practice Class.

name: Task Code
description: The JPS Task Code Reassignment utility replaces one task code with another in all Juris Tables so the original code can be deleted. A supplemental report with last activity date is included.

name: Timekeeper with Notecard
description: The JPS Timekeeper Reassignment Utility with NoteCards allows the user to change billing, originating, and responsible timekeepers for clients and/or matters with an option to add NoteCards to reflect the changes. Utility also contains a pre- and post-report of client and/or matters to be changed.

name: Inactivate Vendors
description: The JPS Vendor Inactivate Utility allows the user to inactivate vendors based on date or by selecting the vendors from a list. This tool also allows the user to select which vendors receive a 1099 by vendor group and assign those vendors a 1099 type.

name: Vendor Discount Account Updater
description: The JPS Vendor Discount Account Update Utility allows the user to update the existing discount general ledger (GL) account for all vendors with the same original value to a new GL account based on the parameter selections.

name: Vendor GL Default Dist Account Updater
description: The JPS Vendor GL Default Dist Account Updater Utility allows the user to update the existing distribution GL account for all vendors with the same original value to a new GL account based on the parameter selections.

name: Vendor Merge
description: The JPS Vendor Merge Utility allows you to pick two vendors and merge them together including vouchers, batches, checks, notes, distributions, and demographic data.

name: Voucher Import
description: The JPS Voucher Import Utility imports data output files without having to manually input vouchers when utilizing third party expense tracking companies such as Chrome River or Concur. Import multiple vouchers through a standard .csv or Microsoft® Excel® file.

name: Hide Old Bank Accounts
description: The JPS - Hide Old Bank Accounts Utility allows you to pick a bank account and remove it from the Tables view in Juris Core, assuming it is not assigned to an office and has had 0 history in at least 9 months.

name: Undo Bank Rec
description: The JPS Undo Bank Rec Utility allows the user to undo a bank account's last bank reconciliation.

name: Trust Transfer
description: Transfers balances from one trust bank to another bank for all matters. Also creates a trust adjustment batch that must be posted for the GL and matter ledgers.

name: Delete Zero Batches
description: The JPS Delete Zero Batch Utility allows the user to delete records that have a zero-batch count based on the type of transaction. Utility also contains a pre-report of client and/or matters to be changed.

name: Hide Old Batches by Date
description: The JPS Hide Old Batches by Date utility allows the user to hide records that have a batch postdate older than a selected date based on the selected criteria.

name: Modify Payer Line in Cash Receipts
description: The JPS Modify Payer Line in Cash Receipts Utility updates the payer line after posting without having to reverse the original cash receipt and reenter with the correct payer information. Change the payer line in cash receipt batch, based on the batch and record number (or all records in a batch).

name: Archive Bill Bulk Print Tool
description: This tool prints to PDF, in bulk, archive invoices based on selection criteria. Expense attachments can also be printed as an option. Only run this tool for up to 2500 invoices at a time. This process is VERY intensive on your machine and the server and printing more than this number (which is system dependent) can cause the tool to crash and can slow down your server. If you have to run the tool over the same invoices again, it will simply skip over the ones already printed.

name: Juris Core Budget Importer
description: This utility allows the user to import Core matter fee and expense budgets based on a spreadsheet.
